hero.eyebrow: Touraine · Châteaux of the Loire Valley
hero.lead: A 16th-century manor house in the heart of the Loire Valley. Perfect for weddings, holidays, seminars and your most memorable moments, just two hours from Paris.

intro.titleLine2Italic: which has been in existence for five centuries.
paragraphs: Built in the 16th century, ten minutes from the Royal Château of Amboise and the Clos Lucé, the Château de la Huberdière is neither a hotel nor a museum. It is a private residence, where guests are welcomed as they always have been here, with care and discretion.
Five centuries of tuffeau stone, weathered wood panelling and marble fireplaces. And a clear commitment: to preserve the spirit of the place, without ever allowing it to become static.
Set in the heart of a twelve-hectare park, between Azay-le-Rideau, Chenonceau and Chambord, La Huberdière welcomes you for an overnight stay, a seminar, a wedding or simply for lunch.

activitiesHead.titleItalic: five ways to be admitted there.
activitiesHead.intro: Bed and breakfast, weddings, corporate seminars, family gatherings, retreats or workshops: every stay is tailored with you in mind, and just for you.

activities.text: Five exceptional rooms, each one different. Period drapes, a four-poster bed, an original fireplace, and a bathroom that has been carefully refurbished. Breakfast is served on the terrace in fine weather, or in the large dining room if the weather is inclement.
points: Breakfast included; set menu available upon booking
Access to the park and the private swimming pool

activities.text: A secular ceremony beneath century-old trees, dinner in the grand vaulted hall, an evening on the terrace, and an overnight stay at the château. Exclusive use of the venue, for 30 to 150 guests. A dedicated point of contact, from the first meeting right through to the day after the celebration.
points: Exclusive private hire of the château and grounds
Accommodation for close family members on site

activities.text: Executive committees, masterclasses, strategic seminars, team-building days. A wood-panelled room for reflection, twelve hectares of grounds for a stroll, and a swimming pool to round off the day. Complete confidentiality guaranteed as the venue is exclusively yours.
points: Fully equipped plenary hall, sub-committee rooms
From 8 to 40 staff, in the privatisation sector

activities.text: Memorable birthdays, extended family gatherings, christenings, and reunions across the generations. The château opens its drawing rooms, prepares its guest rooms and sets the tables beneath the chestnut trees. The moment you arrive, you’ll feel right at home.
points: Accommodation for 14 to 30 people, with extra beds available
Catering service or table d’hôtes, whichever you prefer

activities.text: Yoga courses, creative retreats, writing workshops, meditation sessions. La Huberdière offers its light-filled rooms, gardens and tranquillity to groups of 6 to 25 people for immersive experiences.
points: Bright lounges and outdoor areas available
Seasonal cuisine, with options to suit all tastes (vegetarian, gluten-free)
Day package or residential stay of 2 to 7 days

quote.text: Here, music vies with silence, and it is often silence that prevails.

paragraphs: La Huberdière is tucked away in the countryside around Tours, ten minutes from the Royal Castle of Amboise and the Clos Lucé, Leonardo da Vinci’s final resting place. Azay-le-Rideau, Chenonceau, Villandry and Chambord are all less than an hour away.
From Paris: a 1 hour 5-minute TGV journey to Tours, followed by a twenty-minute drive. There are also direct connections from Bordeaux, Lyon and Nantes.

final.text: A weekend away, a wedding, a seminar, a retreat: tell us about your plans and we’ll get back to you.
final.responseLine: We’ll get back to you within 24 hours
